title: sprites.odin helper header still names the pre-fix proc sprite_target_w
evidence:
// sprite_target_w — the in-game footprint widths (tiles * tile_px * scale).
sprite_house_target :: proc(v: ^View) -> f32 { return 1.50 * v.tile_px * v.scale }
detail: The doc header names sprite_target_w, which exists nowhere (repo-wide grep: only this comment). The helper was split into three procs; the header kept the old name.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the header to name the three footprint procs (sprite_house_target / sprite_host_target / sprite_puck_target).

title: ci-local palcheck gate label diverges from the workflow step name it must mirror
evidence: tools/ci-local.sh:59: "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck" — .github/workflows/ci.yml:90: "- name: Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle)" — tools/ci-local.sh:12: "# semantics (stop on first failure), same per-gate names in the summary."
detail: The GATES label appends " — 7.1" while the workflow step name does not — the only one of the ten gates whose name drifts, breaking ci-local's own stated mirror invariant.
recommended_fix: Drop " — 7.1" from the ci-local.sh gate label (or add it to the workflow step name) so both lists match exactly.
